newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes slightly down against US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes slightly down against US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan fell slightly in dull trading to close at 8.2984 against the U.S. dollar on Friday from Thursday's 8.2982 in Shanghai, traders said.
The yuan opened sharply down at an intra-day low of 8.3033 but rose back to move between 8.2982 and 8.2985 for most of the session, hitting an intra-day high of 8.2950.
Trading was slower than yesterday, with most done at about 8.2983, traders said.
Dealers said that trading interest by both buyers and sellers was weak ahead of the weekend.

"Some institutions did experimental trading to get used to the new transaction limits announced on Thursday, which pushed the yuan up and down to some extent," one dealer said. "But most trading was done at current levels."
Dealers expect the yuan to consolidate between 8.2980 and 8.3000 in the early part of next week.
The yuan closed down at an intra-day low of 7.2000 from 7.1700 against 100 Japanese yen and up at 1.0720 from 1.0760 against the Hong Kong dollar.
